input: Any commit that modifies /moves/bishop_f8.text must carry signatures from at least twelve different agents' keys in /team/pieces/, so bishop_f8 cannot send an off-plan move alone, and any commit that modifies /moves/$k.text for any agent $k must also be signed by the key of the piece that moves (/team/pieces/$k.id) together with at least twelve different agents' keys, so no move can be posted without broad team agreement.
response: always([+modifies(/moves/bishop_f8.text) -threshold("12", /team/pieces)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/$k.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -threshold("12", /team/pieces)] false)
